principle: Cadet housing is finite physical residential capacity. A quarters assignment establishes residence and co-residency context, not current physical presence or a social relationship.
rules: Every housed cadet occupies one real bed/room capacity unit.
A cadet may have at most one current Academy quarters assignment.
Latent and materialized cadets may hold quarters because assignment is anchored to population_slot_ref.
Materializing a cadet does not change their quarters or roommates.
Hard medical, environmental, accessibility, safety or legally represented needs constrain eligible rooms.
Species ID alone never determines room assignment; any species-related need must first resolve into an explicit housing requirement.
Personality never determines mandatory housing compatibility.
Soft preferences may influence assignment only after all hard constraints and capacity rules are satisfied.
No compatible capacity produces an unresolved housing need; the system does not invent a new room.
Temporary leave, field training or training cruise does not automatically release quarters.
Graduation, withdrawal, dismissal, transfer, authorized move or facility change may release/reassign quarters through explicit events.
Quarters assignment defines residence, not guaranteed current location; schedule/presence is Step 5.
Roommate co-residency creates shared-context provenance only and has no automatic friendship, trust, affection, rivalry or romance effect.
The player uses the same housing inventory and assignment rules as other cadets.
